results.title: Slaughterhouse On The Hill
results.overview: A night of terror ensues when a group of friends party at an abandoned slaughterhouse.

results.title: The Fisherman
results.overview: A devout fisherman has his faith tested as a series of supernatural phenomena plague him and his family.

results.title: Ecocide
results.overview: Noah, a charismatic advertisement executive, has just launched the ad campaign of his career for the company Nordic Meat. But when his little sister Naia begins live-streaming from the roof of a Nordic Meat factory, accusing the company of greenwashing and threatening to commit so-called “ecocide” by jumping off the building unless they meet her extremist activist network’s demands, Noah is forced to confront his own values and fight for what matters most.

results.title: Ulises plebeyo
results.overview: Reality, glowing with anxiety, is dissected and reconstructed through editing to generate blocks of pure image-sound through a precarious camera that, for several years, travels incessantly from the confines of underdevelopment to the heights of European prosperity. From a working-class neighborhood in Buenos Aires to St. Mark's Square in Venice. From prison to the plains.

results.title: Un polo de limón
results.overview: Cris is a film student going through a creative crisis. Her professor rejects her latest script because it is empty, conveys no emotion, and advises her that whatever it is that is blocking her, she should put an end to it and fix it, so that she can turn in the script again the following week.

results.title: Supertramp
results.overview: Sometimes Destiny strikes twice

results.title: Brutalist Couture
results.overview: Hieronymus Rivera, a strong force in the New York fashion underground, is offered the deal of a lifetime by Cecilia Meadows, a government official who is the head of a new secret program called DAFTCA. What begins as a simple agreement to design uniforms for the organization, soon finds Hieronymus in the center of a vast web of conspiracy.

results.title: Curry Mee
results.overview: Two rival gangs, one lead by Taiko Raja(S.Gana) and another lead  by Ah Meng (Echo Quah),  are always at odds with each other. One day, an incident occurs in the village where Sulaiman (Ropie) is the respected leader of the local community. Sulaiman finds out about it and brings Raja and Ah Meng together. There on, they become good friends until there is a conflict due to developers, land issues, and the tricks of their gang members. Sulaiman proposes a non violent solution to Raja and Ah Meng, this is when hilarity ensues.

results.title: Locked Out
results.overview: A college student finds himself locked out of his dorm building late at night with none of his roommates home

results.title: Rush Hour
results.overview: A young woman’s heart is torn between her musician boyfriend who is on the brink of fame, and a man who understands her more than anyone.

results.title: Pandemonium
results.overview: When a Forensic Cleaner comes across an unusual crime scene- something about the body defies explanation. Meanwhile, a rookie cop who first on scene becomes violently ill and butchers his entire family in the most cruel and clinical manner. As the Cleaner and police attempt to piece together the clues, a horrifying truth emerges: something is releasing a viral agent that warps the mind, turning those exposed into violent maniacs.

results.title: Wait To Tell Mother
results.overview: A surprise pregnancy forces a woman to make a difficult decision alone, triggering memories of the one person she could always turn to—her father—and leaving her to find strength in his absence.

results.title: Heartsping : Teenieping of Love
results.overview: In order to find her ideal partner, Heartsping, Romi went deep into the mysterious and dangerous magic forest. She was fearless, determined, and brave, and worked with her partners to successfully solve this misunderstanding and rescue Heartsping, who was in a crisis. Heartsping was finally captured by Romi's extraordinary courage and kind heart. Impressed, and teamed up with Romi.

results.title: D.I.Y. Duck
results.overview: Donald Duck's efforts to replace a light bulb end in comic and catastrophic results.

results.title: Mandakini
results.overview: Aromal and Ambili tied the knot.Aromal was really excited and delighted to start a life with Ambili but on that wedding night an unlikely incident happened which will put the entire family in complex situation.

results.title: Watering Hole
results.overview: Two young girls go out to get free drinks from men in a local pub. But as their night and sobriety descends, they realise just how different their morals are, and just how dangerous uk nightlife can be.

results.title: The Body
results.overview: Rich entrepreneur Rebecca Zuin has died from an alleged heart attack, raising suspicions on the part of a police inspector after her body disappears from the morgue. When her handsome young husband becomes a suspect, he starts thinking she may have faked her death to sadistically torment him.

results.title: Daaaaaalí!
results.overview: A young French journalist repeatedly meets iconic surrealist artist Salvador Dalí for a documentary project that never came to be.

results.title: Real
results.overview: 1857. Two peasants find a smartphone in their field.

results.title: Tattletale
results.overview: In 1962, a rural schoolteacher is put to the test when she discovers that her students are being threatened by an ancient evil.
